$Comment: The first piece of gear taken apart at a Disenchanting Table. STATION_INPUT counts a stack the moment a station consumes it, so one finished ritual earns it; the blank Target matches every item, and Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. Requires carries the stations feature: the achievement does not exist on a server without RPG Stations switched on.
Name: Disenchanting_First_Piece
